orgs.name: Finding Hope for FRRS1L
orgs.snippet: We are a parent-led organization dedicated to reducing the suffering and struggle of individuals affected by Frizzle (FRRS1L) genetic disease, by developing Frizzle gene replacement therapy.

orgs.name: Finding Hope for FRRS1L – Patient Registration
orgs.snippet: By registering your child/children with Finding Hope for FRRS1L, it provides valuable information that will help us better understand and track the global map of the FRRS1L community; it will inform researchers conducting a natural history study of FRRS1L; and it also allows us to keep you informed through email updates and news on the progress towards developing gene replacement therapy treatment.
